instruction: Please help me find the score record for the 2021 Super Bowl in the NFL website.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking to find 2021 Super Bowl scores instead of 2019. Uses the same NFL website navigation pattern with URL verification. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the expected 2021 Super Bowl scores page. Uses existing getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' and metric 'is_expected_active_tab' - no custom functions needed.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very similar - only changes the year from 2019 to 2021, maintaining same complexity and navigation pattern

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: 'active_url_from_accessTree' properly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree address bar, handles both ARM/x86 architectures, and adds the correct 'https://www.' prefix
Metric logic is correct: 'is_expected_active_tab' correctly compares the actual URL with expected URL using 'compare_urls' function, handles both dict and string input formats
Expected value is semantically correct: URL 'https://www.nfl.com/scores/2021/post4' is the correct NFL page for 2021 Super Bowl scores (post4 = postseason week 4 = Super Bowl)
Complete coverage: The evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement - checking that the user successfully navigated to the correct 2021 Super Bowl scores page
Data flow is sound: Getter extracts the right state (active tab URL) → Metric compares the right aspect (URL match) → Expected value is correct for this task
